n7763abb666.headline: Armenia drivers resume protest against increase in auto insurance premiums
n7763abb666.summary: Drivers assembled at Shahumyan Square in Yerevan and marched to the car insurance bureau to protest increases in auto insurance premiums.
n7763abb666.why: Mandatory motor insurance premiums affect household costs and the regulated insurance market in Armenia.

n441d34ea84.headline: Australia to open borders to vaccinated travelers this month
n441d34ea84.summary: Australia will open its borders to vaccinated travellers from anywhere in the world starting February 21. It is the first time since March 2020 that people can travel to Australia from anywhere, provided they are inoculated against Covid-19.
n441d34ea84.why: Reopening to international travel affects Australia's tourism, aviation and education sectors, which were heavily hit by border closures during the pandemic.

n0d296799b8.headline: Taiwan lifts forex trading punishment on Deutsche -sources
n0d296799b8.summary: Taiwan's central bank has allowed Deutsche Bank to resume trading Taiwan dollar deliverable and non-deliverable forwards. The penalty had been imposed earlier.
n0d296799b8.why: Deutsche Bank is a major global investment bank, and access to Taiwan dollar forwards matters for its foreign exchange and hedging business.

n32784c0c6d.headline: Abu Dhabi's AD Ports Raises $1B Before Market Debut
n32784c0c6d.summary: Abu Dhabi's AD Ports Group, owned by sovereign wealth fund ADQ, raised 4 billion dirhams ($1.1 billion) through its primary issuance ahead of its market debut.
n32784c0c6d.why: AD Ports operates ports and logistics assets and is majority owned by ADQ, a state investment vehicle, so its listing is a notable Gulf capital markets event.

n17d341ae8b.headline: Inflation, current account deficit biggest challenges: SBP chief
n17d341ae8b.summary: State Bank of Pakistan Governor Reza Baqir named inflation and the current account deficit as the biggest challenges for the economy.
n17d341ae8b.why: The State Bank of Pakistan sets interest rates and manages the rupee, so its views on inflation and external deficits guide investor expectations.

n57bbed6d90.headline: Will panic selloff hurt Adani Wilmar listing? Here
n57bbed6d90.summary: Adani Wilmar's shares are commanding a Rs 22-25 premium in the unofficial grey market, about 10% over its Rs 230 issue price. The premium was about Rs 35 on Friday and Rs 100 earlier.
n57bbed6d90.why: Adani Wilmar is a major Indian consumer-staples company, and grey-market premiums signal expected early trading for newly listed shares.

n220d935075.headline: Sweden's PriceRunner sues Google for 2.1 bn euros
n220d935075.summary: Swedish price comparison site PriceRunner is suing Google for 2.1 billion euros ($2.4 billion), alleging that Google promoted its own search results.
n220d935075.why: Alphabet's Google is the dominant search engine, and antitrust claims over self-preferencing in search results can carry large financial and regulatory consequences.

n9077d213b6.headline: Sweden's PriceRunner sues Google for 2.1 bn euros - Times of India
n9077d213b6.summary: Swedish price comparison site PriceRunner said it is suing Google for 2.1 billion euros, according to a report from Stockholm.
n9077d213b6.why: Alphabet's Google is a major digital advertising and search platform, and antitrust disputes can affect its business and regulatory exposure.

nbe6eb8070d.headline: Mass. unemployment down, but jobless fund picture still fuzzy
nbe6eb8070d.summary: Massachusetts lawmakers received a better picture of the state's Unemployment Insurance Trust Fund but still want more information. Unemployment in the state has declined.
nbe6eb8070d.why: Unemployment insurance trust funds are financed by employer taxes and affect state finances and labour-market policy.

nc516206937.headline: Higher deficit, lack of clarity on fisc consolidation add risks to lowering debt: Report
nc516206937.summary: Fitch Ratings said higher fiscal deficits and a lack of clarity on consolidation plans in the Budget add risks to its projection of lower Indian government debt. The rating agency highlighted these fiscal risks.
nc516206937.why: Fitch is a major credit rating agency, and its sovereign outlook affects borrowing costs and investor demand for Indian government bonds.

n02cf42e90c.headline: Sensex  falls! These  stocks fell 5% or more in Monday
n02cf42e90c.summary: The Sensex fell on Monday, with 42 Nifty stocks closing in the red and only 8 in the green. Several stocks fell 5% or more during the session.
n02cf42e90c.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark equity indices of India's stock market, so broad declines reflect sentiment across Indian listed companies.
n02cf42e90c.why_moved: Most stocks in the Nifty pack ended lower, with 42 closing in the red against 8 in the green, and several falling 5% or more.

n8b9d2aca42.headline: Soaring house prices could see thousands get lower mortgage rates
n8b9d2aca42.summary: Rising house prices could allow thousands of Irish borrowers to qualify for lower mortgage rates, according to a report by Offaly Live. No further detail is given in the input.
n8b9d2aca42.why: Mortgage pricing depends on lending rules and loan-to-value bands, which affect Irish banks' mortgage books and household credit demand.

ndf203486ab.headline: The Italian bank BMPS, the oldest in the world, fires its CEO
ndf203486ab.summary: Monte dei Paschi di Siena, the world's oldest bank, dismissed its CEO following continued internal challenges and board decisions.
ndf203486ab.why: Leadership changes at major banks can signal strategic shifts or instability, impacting investor confidence and banking sector dynamics in Italy and Europe.

n08d8caef99.summary: US local governments are planning to allocate federal pandemic relief funds for economic development projects.

n6f3ec263a9.why: Capital requirements impact bank stability and lending capacity, influencing Singapore's banking sector and financial markets.

n14a10b2eeb.headline: Mahama writes: Time is ticking for the crisis-ridden Ghanaian economy
n14a10b2eeb.summary: Ghana's economy is in crisis with large budget deficits, unsustainable debt, and a depreciating currency, affecting investor confidence.
